_meta.purpose: Curated seed for the CivilCareer course catalogue. Paste this whole file into admin → Courses → Bulk import; every row lands as a draft for review before anything is public.

how.candidates: found with Exa web search restricted to udemy.com and coursera.org (10 searches: AutoCAD/Civil 3D, STAAD, ETABS/SAP2000, Revit/BIM, quantity surveying, estimation, Primavera, geotechnical, highways, construction management, safety, exam preparation)
how.verification: every URL fetched on 2026-10-08 — Coursera pages directly (HTTP 200; coursera.org/learn is allowed by robots.txt), Udemy pages through the r.jina.ai reader; two URLs whose first fetch served a soft redirect were re-verified through Exa. All 73 candidates resolved; none was invented.
how.fields: title, description, rating, enrollment_count, instructor and language are the provider's own page text/figures as read on 2026-10-08. Price, duration, discounts and reviews were NOT read, so they stay empty — the cards say "Price not provided" rather than guessing.
how.classification: 60 rows carry no specialization on purpose: the import runs lib/course-civil.js classifyCourse() on them. 11 rows the classifier refused carry a specialization assigned after reading the provider page — the same override an admin has in the editor.
how.curation: category, career_stage and target_roles are CivilCareer's own curation (the filter facets), not provider claims. source is 'seed'.

excluded.reason: general FE exam review (all disciplines), not Civil Engineering specific
generic GIS overview — weak/indirect Civil Engineering connection

_meta.providerAccess: Automatic provider API access not configured; manual/bulk Civil Engineering course import remains available.
